name: Legends of Talia: Arcadia
source:
Arcadia is a legendary knight who’s fought in innumerable battles in the war-torn land of Talia. She’s beloved by the people, despite her relatively young age, and many consider her a goddess among mortals. She fought in the battle of Kadath in her youth, saved Amaranth Village from destruction, and has defeated hundreds of Talia’s enemies with her sword... But there’s one legend about Arcadia nobody speaks of.

More than ten years ago, a horned dragon attacked Freycross Village. Arcadia happened to be there at the time, and could have saved the lives of the villagers – but she didn’t. The village burnt to the ground, and almost all the villagers perished. Arcadia might be a hero, but those who survived the attack on Freycross Village resent her. They hate her. They even want her dead.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/729530/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
阿卡迪亚是一位传奇骑士，在饱受战争蹂躏的塔利亚土地上经历过无数次战斗。尽管她年纪轻轻，却深受人们的喜爱，许多人认为她是凡人中的女神。她年轻时参加过卡达斯之战，拯救了苋菜村免遭毁灭，并用她的剑击败了数百名塔莉亚的敌人……但关于阿卡迪亚，还有一个无人提及的传说。

十多年前，一条角龙袭击了弗雷克罗斯村。阿卡迪亚当时恰好在那里，本可以拯救村民的生命，但她没有。村庄被烧毁，几乎所有村民都丧生。阿卡迪亚可能是英雄，但弗雷克罗斯村袭击事件中的幸存者却对她心生怨恨。他们讨厌她。他们甚至想要她死。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/729530/]Steam[/url]]
